scripts.test: bun run setup && set -a && eval "$(bunx supabase status -o env)" && set +a && bun test --parallel=1
scripts.test:current: set -a && eval "$(bunx supabase status -o env)" && set +a && bun test --parallel=1
scripts.db:lint: bunx supabase db lint --local --schema public --level warning && bunx supabase db lint --local --schema commerce --level warning
scripts.types:generate: bunx supabase gen types typescript --local > types/database.ts
scripts.types:check: tmp=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; bunx supabase gen types typescript --local > "$tmp" && diff -u types/database.ts "$tmp"
